note: The party ping icons (src/ui/ping_icons.ts): one painted icon per ping kind, shown in the ping wheel, the chat callout, the minimap and (with a glow in the kind's colour) the world marker. No circle or badge: the object alone. Authored on a flat magenta (#FF00FF) key, then keyed to alpha, trimmed, centered and encoded by `node scripts/convert_chrome_icons_webp.mjs --dir public/ui/pings`. The ping colour tokens (--color-ping-* in src/styles/tokens.css, PARTY_PING_COLORS in src/render/party_pings_core.ts) were sampled from this art.
source: OpenAI image generation in ChatGPT, 26 November 2026, one chat with the project's HUD chrome icons as the style reference: the ornate painted classic-MMO icon finish, each icon a single saturated slightly neon colour with bright highlights and a thick very dark outline, no gold, one square image per icon. Full-size sources and the style reference are kept outside the repo (tmp/imagegen/ping-icons-2026-11-26).
